verdict.rationale: Rootly's own docs say incidents can be declared, run, and resolved from Slack, Google Chat, and Microsoft Teams. Workflows create the incident channel in Slack or Teams and automate stakeholder updates, and Rootly in Slack can change severity and page teams. However, no evidence shows incident roles being created or assigned for the responder, and all support comes from vendor docs. Missing for 10: documented automatic role assignment (e.g., incident commander) from chat, depth of the Teams declare/run flow beyond on-call paging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can declare and run an incident from chat — Slack or Teams — with channels, roles, and updates created for me
